timing_correction: The original pilot contains foreground synchronous evidence I/O. Its values cannot trigger acceptance. The follow-up requires three canonical nonblocking remeasurements.
trigger: At least three registered nonblocking, frozen, exact-output-matched starts and observed SLO goodput ratio >= 1.10. This trigger is not a GO decision.
selection: Maximize tuning SLO goodput among cases with exact canonical outputs. Break ties with larger copy chunk and inflight budget.
confirmation: Three new independent starts for tuned generic PD and frontier handoff at identical selected transport budgets. Cross GPU pairs and policy order.
profiling: Separate P2048/C8, N8/cap8 profiles for default generic PD, selected generic PD, and selected-budget frontier handoff. Never use profiled latency as clean serving evidence.
warning: The SLO cell was selected from the predeclared grid after one pilot. Independent confirmation is required. Official-reference fidelity remains 80/100 and is not solved by this control.
novelty_gate: Generic byte pacing is not a loop-specific method. Any surviving gain also requires a boundary-only versus recurrent-frontier streaming ablation before a loop-specific claim.
